$comment: Machine-readable form of docs/traceability.md's 'End-to-end wiring / seam coverage' and 'Boundary verification' tables. Checked by scripts/check-wiring-registry.ts (required CI job wiring-registry-check, per go-host/docs/ADR-028-wiring-boundary-registry.md). Scope deliberately narrow, per LAW-05: the enumerable set of privileged functions and security boundary claims the 2026-09-24 wiring/seam and boundary audits actually found and closed (LAW-07's three named container-runner.ts functions, the Go kernel's capability table, plus the operator-facing mount allowlist check validateAdditionalMounts, which is privileged/security-critical in the same sense despite living in modules/mount-security/ rather than container-runner.ts itself) — never a general 'add anything that seems worth tracking' registry. A new entry needs the same bar: found by one of these two audits (or their successors), not merely 'seemed prudent.'

wiring.note: ADR-024-shaped gap closed 2026-09-24: zero test coverage, dedicated setKernelClientForTests seam unused, no live-Docker leg on either side of the TS/Go boundary.
CLI-derived restart guard path (cliRestart GuardContext), closed 2026-09-24.
Operator mount allowlist, proven on the real buildMounts composition path, closed 2026-09-24.

goKernelCapabilities.note: Live leg is EC-07 (TypeScript-host-in-front shell harness, ADR-023), not a Go test file.
The one capability with no live-Docker leg on either side before 2026-09-24; closed same day.

boundaries.claim: A credential-shaped contributed-env value never reaches a real container's environment.
boundaries.note: Highest-priority boundary finding: EC-07/EC-08 deliberately stub the gateway's credential contribution to avoid exercising this. Closed 2026-09-24.

boundaries.claim: A normally-spawned container's real, inspected mount list matches the request exactly, and a path that was never mounted is unreachable from inside it.
boundaries.note: adversarial_live_docker_test.go's live coverage was scoped narrowly to the docker-socket/.ssh pair; this is the general case.

boundaries.claim: A real spawned agent container has no access to the host's Docker socket unless an operator allowlist explicitly permits it.
boundaries.note: Pre-existing (EC-05); included here for a complete registry rather than because it was a 2026-09-24 finding.

boundaries.claim: The approval CAS (transitionPendingApprovalStatus) allows a held action to execute exactly once, even under concurrent resolution.
The kernel rejects a mismatched NDJSON protocol version over a real Unix socket.
boundaries.note: Already live-verified before the 2026-09-24 audit (TestServe_RoundTripOverUnixSocket + TestDispatch_RejectsUnsupportedVersion); included for a complete registry.

boundaries.claim: A guard grant approved for one agent group/command cannot be replayed to authorize a different one.
boundaries.note: Already live-verified against a real DB before the 2026-09-24 audit; included for a complete registry.
